description: This file provides a lightweight wrapper around the fetch API to facilitate HTTP requests, including support for timeout, JSON parsing, error handling, and environment-based URL construction. It exposes functions for GET, POST, and multipart uploads, as well as utility to determine if mock mode should be used.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL from a relative path, using the API base URL from environment configuration.

methods.name: parseResponse(resp)
methods.description: Attempts to parse the fetch response as JSON; if it fails, falls back to plain text.

methods.name: httpRequest(path, { method = 'GET', headers = {}, body, timeoutMs = 12000, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with configurable method, headers, body, timeout, and cancellation signal. Handles JSON encoding of request body and response parsing.

methods.name: httpGet(path, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path and returns the parsed response data.

methods.name: httpPost(path, body, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON-encoded body and returns the parsed response data.

methods.name: httpUpload(path, formData, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a multipart/form-data upload using FormData.

methods.name: isMockMode()
methods.description: Checks whether the application is running in mock mode, i.e., when no API base URL is configured.

ctags.name: httpGet
ctags.pattern: /^export async function httpGet(path, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: httpPost
ctags.pattern: /^export async function httpPost(path, body, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: httpRequest
ctags.pattern: /^export async function httpRequest(path, { method = 'GET', headers = {}, body, timeoutMs = 12000,/

ctags.name: httpUpload
ctags.pattern: /^export async function httpUpload(path, formData, { headers = {}, timeoutMs, signal } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: method
ctags.pattern: /^  const opts = { method, headers: { ...headers }, signal: controller.signal };$/

fields.name: const opts = { method, headers: { ...headers }, signal: controller.signal };
